```yaml
name: Integration Nightly

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  generate-matrix:
    name: Generate Integration Matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - id: set-matrix
        run: |
          # Generate the 253‑config matrix JSON
          npx ts-node integration-tests/matrix-generator.ts > matrix.json
          echo "matrix=$(cat matrix.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  integration-test:
    name: Run Integration Tests
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Run tests against yarn fixture
        run: |
          node integration-tests/integration-runner.ts \
            --config "${{ matrix.config }}" \
            --fixture fixtures/yarn-app
        continue-on-error: false
      - name: Run tests against npm fixture
        run: |
          node integration-tests/integration-runner.ts \
            --config "${{ matrix.config }}" \
            --fixture fixtures/npm-app
        continue-on-error: false

  community-tests:
    name: Run Community Repo Tests
    needs: integration-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Execute community runner
        run: |
          node integration-tests/community-runner.ts
        continue-on-error: false
```
